budget_rationale: Agent-selected operational target: each complete build-time certification or deployment recheck must fit five minutes (ten minutes per pair). Controlled published A1 cost was 164.79 s certification/136.48 s verification; A4 142.91/142.30 s. The target leaves room for useful module growth while bounding deployment/CI waiting. Per-stage published limits remain unchanged; later candidate failure cannot relax these budgets silently.
build_binding: Every attempt references this profile hash and a separate exact build manifest; baseline expected policy identities here must be mapped explicitly if a versioned identity changes while preserving the original semantic request.

conditions.cpu_quota: max at every visible non-root cgroup ancestor
conditions.heavy_runs: sequential, no overlapping feature proof/build/benchmark runs
conditions.memory_reservation: No dedicated reservation; validate availability at start and retain competing-load observations
conditions.os_page_cache: uncontrolled; fresh workspace is not OS-cold

coverage_note: Finite measured acceptance envelope, not a mathematical completeness theorem or an enforced maximum action count. A256/A512 are floors; no language construct is removed to make the profile pass. Existing valid v1 regression groups remain required separately. Higher sizes may be characterized without silently changing this accepted corpus.
dimension_interactions: actions x FO permission density and policies
dependency count x guards and shared parent
generated actions x authored FO actions x lifecycle dependencies

measurement.consumed_heartbeats_and_recursion: unavailable, never equated to configured limits
measurement.memory: sampled sum of process-tree RSS/VmSize; shared pages may be counted repeatedly
measurement.scope: separate processes; process startup/input staging through public result/evidence persistence
